svg.title: Figure 03 · Volatility and total-variance coordinates
svg.desc: Synthetic SSVI reference surface; spot 100, continuous rate 3% and yield 1%. Maturities 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 and 3 years; w = sigma squared times T.
